policies.title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Saint Vincent and the Grenadines waives visas for listed ordinary passports for stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to a valid Saint Vincent and the Grenadines ordinary passport expressly listed in the treaty annex.
For the modeled short visitor/non-remunerated subset, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A long-stay visa is required to seek residence documentation or stay longer than 90 days.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Uruguayan ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Uruguay waives visas for a listed Uruguayan international passport for stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to a valid Uruguayan international passport listed in the treaty annex; special return and emergency documents are outside this ordinary-passport policy.
For the modeled short visitor/non-remunerated subset, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A visit longer than 90 days, regardless of purpose, requires a visa before entry.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Saint Kitts and Nevis waives visas for ordinary passports for stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to the ordinary Saint Kitts and Nevis passport expressly listed in the treaty annex.
For the modeled short visitor/non-remunerated subset, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A visit longer than 90 days, regardless of purpose, requires a visa before entry.

Travel uses border crossing points equipped in accordance with the parties' laws; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Antigua and Barbuda ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Antigua and Barbuda waives visas for listed ordinary passports for stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to the valid Antigua and Barbuda passport listed in the treaty annex, distinct from the separately listed official and diplomatic passports.
For the modeled short visitor/non-remunerated subset, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A visit longer than 90 days, regardless of purpose, requires a visa before entry.
Travel uses border crossing points in accordance with the parties' laws; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Panamanian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Panama waives visas for the listed Panamanian passport for tourism and other non-profit activities for up to 90 days during 180 days from the date of first entry.
conditions: Applies to the valid Panamanian passport listed in the treaty annex; this policy models its ordinary-passport visitor use.
Visa-free travel covers tourism and other non-profit activities for up to 90 days in any 180-day period from first entry.
Longer stays, employment, and study require the appropriate visa under Ukrainian law.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Paraguayan ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Paraguay waives visas for the Paraguayan citizen passport in the annex for stays of up to 90 days in six calendar months.
conditions: Applies to the Paraguayan citizen passport in the MERCOSUR format listed in the treaty annex; diplomatic, service, and return documents are separately listed or outside this ordinary-passport policy.
For short visitor/non-remunerated travel, the treaty waives visas for entry to Ukraine and a stay of up to 90 days in six calendar months from entry.
A stay over 90 days, profit-making activity, or temporary or permanent residence requires a visa and the relevant authorization.
Travel uses crossings open to international traffic; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Grenadian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Grenada waives visas for ordinary passports for tourism or unpaid activities for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to a Grenadian ordinary passport valid for at least six months from entry, as expressly specified by the treaty.
Visa-free travel covers tourism or unpaid activities for up to 90 days in any 180-day period, whether in one trip or several trips.
A visa is required before entry for a stay longer than 90 days; paid activities are outside the treaty's visa-free purpose scope.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Peruvian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force short-stay treaty with Peru waives visas for ordinary passports for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to a Peruvian ordinary passport valid for at least six months from entry into Ukraine, as expressly specified by the treaty annex.
For short visitor/non-remunerated travel, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A stay longer than 90 days or paid activity requires a visa before entry; any more favorable Ukrainian statutory condition remains governed by Ukrainian law.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.title: Dominica ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Dominica waives visas for ordinary passports for stays of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to a valid ordinary passport of the Commonwealth of Dominica, which the treaty expressly distinguishes from diplomatic and official passports.
For the modeled short visitor/non-remunerated subset, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A visit longer than 90 days, except for treaty-accreditation cases, requires a visa before entry regardless of purpose.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.

policies.summary: Ukraine's current in-force treaty with Ecuador waives visas for ordinary passports for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
conditions: Applies to the Ecuadorian ordinary passport expressly listed in the treaty annex, distinct from diplomatic, official, and service passports.
For short visitor/non-remunerated travel, the treaty waives visas for entry, stay, exit, and transit in Ukraine for up to 90 days in any 180-day period.
A stay longer than 90 days or paid activity requires a visa before entry.

The territorial scope is Ukraine through international passenger border crossings; operational, security, martial-law, carrier, and final-admission conditions remain separate from the current treaty force.
